instruction: Write a minimal GitHub Actions workflow named hello that runs on every push to main and prints a greeting.
output:
name: hello
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  greet:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Greet
        run: echo "Hello from GitHub Actions"

instruction: Create a workflow that checks out the repository and runs the project test suite with make test on every push.
output:
name: tests
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run tests
        run: make test

instruction: Write a workflow that prints the versions of Python, Node.js, and Docker that ship with the GitHub-hosted runner.
output:
name: tool-versions
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Show tool versions
        run: |
          python3 --version
          node --version
          docker --version

instruction: Build a workflow that checks out the code, sets up Python, installs requirements, and runs the build script.
output:
name: build
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Build
        run: python scripts/build.py

instruction: Define workflow-level environment variables APP_ENV and LOG_LEVEL and reference them from a run step.
output:
name: env-demo
on: push
env:
  APP_ENV: staging
  LOG_LEVEL: debug
jobs:
  show:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Print environment
        run: echo "env=$APP_ENV level=$LOG_LEVEL"

instruction: Write a workflow where the job runs all steps inside the ./app subdirectory using working-directory.
output:
name: app-ci
on: push
jobs:
  app:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./app
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

instruction: Create a workflow that sets a default shell and working directory for all run steps via the defaults keyword.
output:
name: defaults-demo
on: push
defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash
    working-directory: scripts
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./check.sh

instruction: Write a workflow with a step that only executes when a lockfile exists in the repository.
output:
name: conditional-step
on: push
jobs:
  maybe-install:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install dependencies
        if: ${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') != '' }}
        run: npm ci

instruction: Add a non-critical lint step with continue-on-error so the rest of the job still succeeds when it fails.
output:
name: tolerant-lint
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Experimental lint
        continue-on-error: true
        run: ./tools/experimental-lint.sh
      - name: Build
        run: make build

instruction: Set a job-level timeout of 15 minutes so long-running steps are cancelled automatically.
output:
name: timed-build
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build

instruction: Write a workflow with top-level permissions restricted to read-only repository contents.
output:
name: read-only
on: push
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: git log -1 --oneline

instruction: Pin the workflow to the ubuntu-24.04 runner image instead of ubuntu-latest and run a quick sanity check.

  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

instruction: Create a run step with a multi-line script that enables strict bash mode with set -euo pipefail.
output:
name: strict-bash
on: push
jobs:
  script:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Strict script
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "step one"
          ./scripts/verify.sh

instruction: Add a concurrency group named ci with cancel-in-progress so superseded runs are cancelled.
output:
name: concurrency-ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: ci
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make ci

instruction: Write a workflow that exports a value to GITHUB_ENV in one step and reads it in a later step.
output:
name: github-env
on: push
jobs:
  env-chain:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Set variable
        run: echo "BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Use variable
        run: echo "built at $BUILD_TIME"

instruction: Create a step that writes an output with GITHUB_OUTPUT and a following step that consumes it.
output:
name: step-outputs
on: push
jobs:
  outputs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Produce output
        id: meta
        run: echo "version=1.4.2" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Consume output
        run: echo "The version is ${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"

instruction: Check out the repository without persisting the GITHUB_TOKEN in the local git config.
output:
name: no-credentials
on: push
jobs:
  checkout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: git status

instruction: Write a workflow that executes a project shell script located at scripts/ci.sh with bash.
output:
name: run-project-script
on: push
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run CI script

instruction: Append build metrics to the job summary using the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment file.
output:
name: step-summary
on: push
jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Write summary
        run: |
          echo "## Build report" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- status: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- duration: 42s" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

instruction: Upload the dist directory as a build artifact with actions/upload-artifact after running the build.
output:
name: upload-dist
on: push
jobs:
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
